sentences.en: Please refrain from making posts that disrupt this site's atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 请勿发布可能扰乱本社区氛围的内容。

sentences.en: Traffic on this road has been disrupted due to flooding.
sentences.zh: 由于洪水，这条路上的交通已被中断。

sentences.en: Train services have been disrupted by the bad weather.
sentences.zh: 恶劣天气导致了列车服务的中断。

senses.zh: 破坏；使瓦解；使分裂；使中断；使陷于混乱
